trigger_condition: npm config get prefix emits no stdout line (error to stderr, empty output)
guard_snippet: $raw = & $NpmPath config get prefix | Select-Object -First 1; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($raw)) { return 'portable' }
potential_consequence: ToString() on $null or Test-Path -LiteralPath '' throws under ErrorActionPreference Stop; installer aborts

trigger_condition: NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX or global npmrc equals legacy path; npm config get returns merged value, not user-only
guard_snippet: if ($env:NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX) { skip migration } else { read prefix from $env:USERPROFILE\.npmrc directly }
potential_consequence: No-op delete reported as migration; install lands in legacy prefix via env while shims and PATH entry are removed

trigger_condition: Effective prefix equals legacy via NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX or global npmrc, not the user npmrc
guard_snippet: [ -z "${NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX:-}" ] && grep -q '^prefix=' "$HOME/.npmrc" before treating it as a user-level override
potential_consequence: Misleading 'ran delete' message; override persists and npm-global install still goes to legacy prefix

trigger_condition: User npmrc prefix stored with trailing slash, ~ form, or differently normalized HOME path
potential_consequence: Legacy override not detected; global installs keep being redirected into CodeMie prefix

trigger_condition: Legacy override migrated and mode resolves to npm-global while legacy prefix/bin remains on PATH
guard_snippet: case ":$PATH:" in *":$LEGACY_PREFIX/bin:"*) echo "Remove $LEGACY_PREFIX/bin from PATH in your shell profile";; esac
potential_consequence: Stale codemie in legacy prefix/bin shadows the newly installed copy

trigger_condition: Legacy migrated, resolved mode npm-global, but npm default global bin (%APPDATA%\npm) is not on PATH
potential_consequence: Shims and PATH entry removed; codemie command not found after install

trigger_condition: User PATH entry for BinDir stored with trailing backslash
potential_consequence: Stale PATH entry kept pointing at a directory whose shims were deleted

trigger_condition: Win32 run from project-local node_modules\@codemieai\code or npx cache
potential_consequence: Self-update runs npm install -g --prefix <project or npx cache>, writing global layout there

trigger_condition: Derived self prefix differs from npm global prefix where agent packages are installed
potential_consequence: Agent-installed codemie bin in global prefix shadows CodeMie and is never repaired

trigger_condition: First npm prefix -g call fails or throws transiently
guard_snippet: cachedGlobalPrefix = p.then(v => { if (v === null) cachedGlobalPrefix = undefined; return v; }, e => { cachedGlobalPrefix = undefined; throw e; });
potential_consequence: Null/rejection memoized; later self-update omits --prefix and installs into wrong prefix
Relative legacy path resolved against cwd; doctor check compares against wrong location

trigger_condition: Portable mode set user npm prefix so CodeMie's later npm install -g of agents targeted writable prefix
guard_snippet: pass --prefix <portable prefix> to agent installGlobal when self prefix is non-default, or document requirement
potential_consequence: Portable users (non-writable default prefix) get EPERM when codemie installs agents

trigger_condition: user-prefix mode redirected all npm install -g, including CodeMie-driven agent installs, to writable prefix
guard_snippet: derive and pass --prefix for agent installs when running from user prefix, or print guidance
potential_consequence: Agent installs via codemie hit EACCES on non-writable global prefix
